workflow:
name: Fixture
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  merge_group:
permissions:
  contents: read
env:
  GLOBAL: yes
jobs:
  test:
    name: Test (${{ matrix.python }}, ${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python: ["3.11", "3.12"]
        os: [linux, macos]
        exclude:
          - python: "3.12"
            os: macos
        include:
          - python: "3.13"
            os: linux
    permissions:
      contents: read
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    services:
      db:
        image: postgres@sha256:dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
      - run: |
          python -m unittest
        env:
          SEED: "42"
        working-directory: src
invalid_yaml:
on: push
on: pull_request
x: &anchor value
y: *anchor
x: !!python/object:danger {}
x: !!str safe
{a: 1, a: 2}
x: .nan
